scheduler.discovery: Onetime::Jobs::Registry.load_all! requires every lib/onetime/jobs/scheduled/**/*_job.rb and schedules each named ScheduledJob subclass that implements its own .schedule; abstract intermediates are filtered out.
scheduler.registration: Each job decides for itself whether to register: .schedule returns early unless its own enablement check passes, so a disabled job is absent from the schedule rather than registered and skipped.
scheduler.overlap: rufus-scheduler does not prevent overlapping runs. Only DomainRefreshJob passes overlap: false. The maintenance base class states that jobs with non-idempotent repair logic would need their own datastore lock.
scheduler.coordination: No cross-process lock exists for scheduled jobs. The source states the single-instance assumption: one scheduler process per datastore.
scheduler.run_records: Every run is recorded through Onetime::Jobs::JobRun with a status of success, partial, skipped or error; a raising block is recorded as error and logged, and the scheduler keeps running.
scheduler.liveness: The scheduler registers a raw rufus heartbeat (not a ScheduledJob, so it never lists itself) every 60 seconds with overlap: false.
scheduler.signals: INT and TERM shut the scheduler down after waiting for running jobs; USR1 logs the current schedule.

evidence.note: boot, discovery, heartbeat, signal handlers, registration logging
one discovery shared by the scheduler, the colonel endpoint and `ots scheduler status`
cron/every/in/at helpers, run recording and outcome classification
overlapping runs are not prevented
overlap: false and the single-scheduler assumption

records.trigger: every 5 minutes, first run 30 seconds after start

records.trigger: every jobs.domain_refresh.check_interval (shipped default 30m), first run 2 minutes after start

records.overlap: overlap: false. A tick that fires while the previous run is still working is skipped, not queued. The guard is per process only.

records.trigger: every jobs.expiration_warnings.check_interval (shipped default 1h), first run 30 seconds after start
records.enabled_by: jobs.expiration_warnings.enabled must be exactly true; shipped default false.

records.enabled_by: both jobs.favicon_backfill.enabled and jobs.favicon_fetch.enabled must be exactly true. Shipped defaults: favicon_backfill false, favicon_fetch true.

records.trigger: every 60 seconds, first run 1 second after start

records.effects: Refreshes the scheduler heartbeat record that `ots scheduler status` and the colonel jobs view read. It is a raw scheduler entry rather than a job class, so it never appears in the job list. Liveness is judged against a window of three heartbeat intervals.
